source: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), eMigrate Portal, NORKA-Roots

UAE.name: United Arab Emirates
key_rules: All workers going on employment visa MUST obtain Emigration Clearance from the Protector of Emigrants (PoE)
Employer must be registered on the eMigrate system
Employment contract must be attested by the UAE Ministry of Human Resources (MOHRE)
Workers must NOT pay any recruitment fees – the employer bears all costs as per UAE law
Tourist visa CANNOT be used for employment – this is illegal
Only licensed Recruiting Agents (RAs) registered with MEA can process overseas employment
Demand letter from the foreign employer must be attested by the Indian Embassy in the UAE
required_documents: Employment visa (NOT tourist visa for work)
Emigration clearance from PoE (for ECR passport holders)
Medical fitness certificate from approved center
Insurance policy (Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana or equivalent)
red_flags_for_fraud: Agent asks for money upfront for visa processing
No official company name, address, or trade license number provided
Offering employment on a tourist/visit visa
Salary promises significantly above market rate (e.g., laborer offered AED 10,000+/month)
Only WhatsApp contact, no official email or office address
Agent is not registered with MEA / does not have an RA license number
Pressure to make a quick decision or send money immediately
No proper employment contract provided before travel
Agent says emigration clearance is 'not needed'
Offering 'free visa' or 'Azad visa' for independent work

salary_ranges.note: Approximate monthly salaries in AED for common roles (2024-2025)

Saudi Arabia.name: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
key_rules: Emigration clearance is mandatory for ECR passport holders
Employer must be verified through eMigrate
Employment contract must be in Arabic and English
Workers should NOT surrender their passport to employer
Iqama (residency permit) must be arranged by employer within 90 days

Qatar.name: State of Qatar
key_rules: Emigration clearance mandatory for ECR passport holders
Qatar has abolished the kafala (sponsorship) system – workers can change jobs
Minimum wage of QAR 1,000/month plus food and accommodation

general_rules.ecr_passports: Holders of ECR (Emigration Check Required) passports MUST get emigration clearance from the Protector of Emigrants before traveling for employment.
general_rules.recruitment_agents: Only Recruiting Agents licensed by MEA can process overseas employment. Verify agent license at emigrate.gov.in.
general_rules.no_fees: As per Indian Emigration Act, workers should NOT be charged more than the prescribed maximum fee by recruiting agents.
general_rules.contract_must: Always get a written employment contract BEFORE traveling. Never travel on verbal promises.
general_rules.insurance: Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) or equivalent insurance is mandatory for ECR workers.
